content.text: LIC Jeevan Utsav (Plan 771) is a non-linked, non-participating whole-life savings plan with a limited Premium Paying Term (PPT). The two headline features are:

items: Guaranteed Additions (GAs) during the PPT — calculated at ₹40 per ₹1,000 Basic Sum Assured per year.
Lifetime income after PPT — choose Regular Income (a fixed 10% of Basic Sum Assured per year) or Flexi Income (defer and accumulate income at a guaranteed ~5.5% p.a.).

content.text: This makes Jeevan Utsav attractive when you want a guaranteed, post-PPT income stream without market risk.

sections.title: How the LIC Jeevan Utsav Calculator works (transparent, brochure-faithful)

content.text:
Premium & mode conversion

We start with the base annual premium and then apply LIC's official modal loading factors to calculate half-yearly (x 0.5098), quarterly (x 0.2575), and monthly (x 0.0879) premiums.

Guaranteed Additions (GAs)

The formula is: GA per year = (BSA/1000) × 40. GAs of ₹40 per ₹1,000 BSA accrue at the end of each policy year, but only during the Premium Paying Term (PPT). For example, for a ₹10 Lakh BSA, the annual GA is (10,00,000 / 1000) * 40 = ₹40,000. Over a 12-year PPT, this totals ₹4.8 Lakh.

Income options

Regular Income: 10% of BSA each policy year after PPT for life.
Flexi Income: Unclaimed income accrues at 5.5% p.a. compounding; you can then withdraw up to 75% of the accumulated pool in a financial year.

Death benefit (during/after PPT)

The death benefit is the higher of (Sum Assured on Death) or (105% of total premiums paid); Sum Assured on Death is defined in the brochure (commonly higher of BSA or 7× annualized premium).

Riders impact

Adding riders will increase your premium but does not change the calculation for Guaranteed Additions or the 10% income rule. They provide separate, additional benefits on specific events.

sections.title: Benefit Illustrations: Real-World Scenarios from the LIC Jeevan Utsav Plan Calculator

content.text:
Scenario A: Early Planner (Age 30, Regular Income)

Inputs: BSA ₹10L, PPT 12 years.

Cashflow: You pay ≈₹85,500/year for 12 years. You accrue a total of ₹4.8L in Guaranteed Additions. From year 13 onwards, you receive a tax-free income of ₹1,00,000 every year for life.

Scenario B: Mid-Career Planner (Age 40, Flexi Income)

Inputs: BSA ₹20L, PPT 10 years.

Cashflow: You pay ≈₹2.1L/year for 10 years. From year 11, you are entitled to ₹2L/year. You choose not to withdraw for 5 years. Your accumulated pool grows at 5.5% p.a. to ≈₹11.8 Lakhs. You can then start making partial withdrawals as needed.

Scenario C: Pre-Retirement (Age 50, with Riders)

Inputs: BSA ₹15L, PPT 8 years.

Cashflow: Base premium is ≈₹2.5L/year. Adding an Accidental Death & Disability rider might increase it to ≈₹2.52L/year. The income logic remains unchanged: you still receive ₹1.5L/year (10% of BSA) for life after the 8-year PPT.

items: Eligibility: Entry age from 90 days to 65 years. Minimum BSA is ₹5,00,000.
Benefit Triggers: Guaranteed Additions are paid during PPT. Income starts from the end of the deferment period (2 years after PPT ends).

Riders: You can add LIC’s Accidental Death and Disability Benefit Rider, Accident Benefit Rider, New Term Assurance Rider, New Critical Illness Benefit Rider, and Premium Waiver Benefit Rider, subject to conditions.

Loan & Surrender: A loan is available after the policy acquires a surrender value (typically after 2 years of premium payments). You can surrender the policy, but it is often financially better to make it 'Paid-up' to retain a reduced death benefit and receive a payout at maturity. Always compare these options carefully. For more details refer to the official LIC product page.

sections.title: Jeevan Utsav vs Jeevan Umang vs New Jeevan Anand: A Quick Guide

content.text:
80C Deduction: Premiums paid are eligible for deduction under Section 80C.
10(10D) Exemption: The income benefits and death benefit are tax-free under Section 10(10D), subject to conditions.
GST: Life insurance premiums typically attract GST at 4.5% in the first year and 2.25% thereafter. Always confirm final tax implications with LIC or a financial advisor.

conclusion.title: Conclusion: A Lifelong Income Stream for a Secure Future
conclusion.body: LIC's Jeevan Utsav is a powerful tool for anyone seeking a guaranteed, lifelong income stream after a limited premium payment period. Whether you choose the predictable 'Regular Income' or the flexible 'Flexi Income' option to grow your wealth, this plan is an excellent choice for creating a secure, lifelong financial legacy. It's best suited for individuals looking for a reliable, non-market-linked income stream in their post-retirement years, combining savings and protection in one powerful package.

mainEntity.name: What are Guaranteed Additions in Jeevan Utsav?

acceptedAnswer.text: Guaranteed Additions accrue at ₹40 per ₹1,000 Basic Sum Assured at the end of each policy year during the Premium Paying Term only.

mainEntity.name: What is Regular vs Flexi Income?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular Income pays 10% of Basic Sum Assured annually for life after PPT. Flexi Income allows you to defer income; unclaimed income accrues at 5.5% p.a. compounded and you can withdraw part of the accumulated pool.
The death benefit is the higher of the Sum Assured on Death or 105% of total premiums paid up to date of death, subject to product terms.
